description: A set of open-end (equity) fleet lease rate quotes, one per vehicle, from a fleet leasing company to a single lessee.

lessor.description: The lessor / leasing company named in the quote notes (the trust that will own the vehicles).

fleet_manager.description: The fleet management company whose quote this is (logo and maintenance notes).

lessee.description: The lessee organization the quotes are prepared for (Prepared For, first line, and the LESSEE line). The organization, not the individual contact.

quotes.description: One entry per lease rate quote, in document order. Each quote starts on a page headed 'Open-End (Equity) Lease Rate Quote' with 'Page 1 of N'.

quote_number.description: Quote No. printed at the top right of every page of this quote.

quote_date.description: Date the quote was prepared (the Date field at the top right of the rate page), as printed.

vehicle.description: The vehicle being quoted, from the header block of the rate page.

series.description: Series / trim description, e.g. cab, drive and wheelbase.

exterior_color.description: Exterior color from the Order Information box.

term_months.description: Lease term in months (the Term field in the header).

state.description: State of the lease, from the header.

capitalized_price_of_vehicle.description: Capitalized Price of Vehicle, in dollars: the first amount in the left-hand dollar column.

courtesy_delivery_fee.description: Other: Courtesy Delivery Fee, in dollars, if shown.

total_capitalized_amount.description: Total Capitalized Amount (Delivered Price), in dollars.

depreciation_reserve.description: Monthly Depreciation Reserve, in dollars (not the percentage).

depreciation_reserve_rate_percent.description: The percentage after 'Depreciation Reserve @', e.g. 1.3 for 1.3000%.

monthly_lease_charge.description: Monthly Lease Charge (based on interest rate, subject to a floor), in dollars.

total_monthly_rental_excluding_services.description: Total Monthly Rental Excluding Additional Services, in dollars.

full_maintenance_program.description: Monthly Full Maintenance Program fee, in dollars, under Additional Fleet Management.

contract_miles.description: Contract Miles for the Full Maintenance Program.

overmileage_charge_per_mile.description: OverMileage Charge per mile, in dollars.

total_monthly_rental_including_services.description: Total Monthly Rental Including Additional Services, in dollars: the all-in monthly payment.

reduced_book_value_at_term.description: Reduced Book Value at the end of the term ('Reduced Book Value at N Months'), in dollars.

service_charge_at_termination.description: Service Charge Due at Lease Termination, in dollars.

estimated_annual_mileage.description: Estimated annual mileage the quote is based on.

pricing_summary.description: Pricing Summary table on the Vehicle Information page: totals in the INVOICE and MSRP columns.
